query:
INSERT INTO `productVariants` (productId, size, price, isAvailable) 
SELECT id, '30ml', CAST(CAST(price AS DECIMAL(10,2)) * 0.75 AS DECIMAL(10,2)), true FROM products
UNION ALL
SELECT id, '50ml', price, true FROM products;
